description: List every provider's image models with lifecycle, reference support and price for one shape: each model's price per image at the requested aspect ratio and quality, whether it fits this server's ceiling, who pays, and what auto would pick. The only way to discover OpenRouter model ids. sortByCost and maxPerProvider surface the cheapest options.

aspect_ratio.description: The shape to price: its billed size decides each model's price.

includeRetired.description: Retired models are hidden unless this is true.

maxPerProvider.description: Cap models listed per provider (cheapest first when sortByCost is set).

max_cost_usd.description: The most for the whole call. Defaults to the server's ceiling for the count.

reference_count.description: How many reference images the call will send; auto skips models that bill them.

sortByCost.description: Sort each provider's models cheapest-first and order providers by their cheapest model.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID from list_brandbrain_workspaces. Shows which workspace key pays for each model; use the workspace your flow is in.

name: list_image_models
title: List image models
